notes.title: Warrior Amazons
notes.content:
Ibrahim ibn Jacob lived in early medieval Europe and was a traveller, merchant and chronicler, in addition to being involved in the slave trade. He is believed to have been involved in espionage for the Moors. It is thanks to him that we have information that Amazons lived in the area of Pomerania, between Kolobrzeg and Gdansk. Some have accused Ibrahim of taking these Amazons from literary tradition. Nevertheless, he claimed to have heard about them from Otto I! Over the centuries, scholars have approached this subject differently. Textbooks omit the account of the City of Women, and there is no corresponding source confirming the details of Ibrahim's account, but it is worth knowing about the existence of this story, especially in the light of recent research on warrior women in Europe.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35900034/8a459998dbcff6593078f4a24447d8b5d3af84ad.jpg[/img]

In the game we will have the opportunity to meet these Amazons. Whether or not they were real is unknown. However, the vision was so intriguing that we decided to create our own story based on this legend. If you want to find out what the Amazons of Pomerania have in common with the Ice Giants, be sure to dive into our game. Learn about the many mythical stories and face the warrior Amazons.

Add to Wishlist, the game's release is fast approaching!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1155850/Lost_Viking_Kingdom_of_Women/

notes.title: LOST VIKING live at Steam Next Fesitval June 2023
notes.content:
Early Middle Ages, 9th century, Eastern Europe. The Viking boats are drifting inland, looking for a convenient place for settlement. One of the greatest and the smartest warrior who was the leader of the expedition was Ragnald. Together with his wife as well as travel companions, they were looking for a safe land, rich in water, vegetation, and animals.

He was also accompanied by his faithful friend, Raga the wolf. It was supposed to be a peaceful voyage, but the expedition fell into an ambush set by women from the Kingdom of Women. Ruthless warriors captured women and killed all men. Almost everyone...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35900034/489f5bb7f35626e55c1af53014dbb5e9092234d9.jpg[/img]

With the help of Raga, the wounded Ragnald survived, and with little strength left the wolfhound pulled him to the other side of the river. Just before he fainted, he noticed his beloved Tove among the captives. When he awoke, his faithful wolf was laying next to him, and apart from the voices of nature, there was no sign of the attackers or the captured women.

Explore the beginning of the adventure of Viking and his wolf, solve the first guesses, experience the first day of the adventure. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1155850/Lost_Viking_Kingdom_of_Women/

notes.title: March Summary
notes.content:
[h3]🐺 New Features and Optimization in the Lost Viking Kingdom of Women 🐺[/h3]

Hi there! I'm excited to present to you the devlog from the last month of our project, Lost Viking Kingdom of Women. During this time, we worked hard to improve the game and accomplished many interesting things.

We started with the spring cleaning of the project. During this time, we focused on optimizing the game, which allowed us to improve its performance. This, in turn, resulted in an increase in FPS, which is a great effect on our work. But that's not all, because we also added new colliders so that players won't fall off the board anymore.

But that's not all! We decided to end the boring walking and stone-collecting, so we created new, interesting puzzle mechanics. Now the game is much more diverse and interesting.
In the Lost Viking Kingdom of Women, we also introduced many new features, and one of them is the ability to interact with a wolf. Now players can control it and establish a positive relationship with it, which is very important in our game. The wolf accompanies the player on their adventures and helps them solve puzzles and perform tasks. This is another interesting option that brings a lot of positive emotions to the gameplay.

Lastly, I have another surprise for you - in the Lost Viking Kingdom of Women, we introduce hunting rabbits! We will have to quickly follow its scent to find it. This challenge will surely provide a lot of excitement and fun.

We hope that our work and improvements will appeal to you. We will continue to work on the project to offer you the best quality gameplay.

[previewyoutube=nKVboGyRFEQ;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]See you in the next devlog![/h3]


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1155850/Lost_Viking_Kingdom_of_Women/

We will no longer stand by and watch, and we will enter the wolf's skin ourselves. Further, we will have to explore and collect materials and craft items. notes.title: Devlog #9 Raga the Wolf
notes.content:
Heil!

Hunting along with the wolf is key for survival in hostile lands. Recently Raga has learned a few tricks.

The first is critter hunting. Raga is able to catch and bring rabbits for our Viking. It's a good source of food for both survivors and brings some animal leather as well.

The second is a distraction. Ragnald is wounded and unarmed after the crash so he can't fight much. Raga provides a distraction that is very helpful when we need to sneak past guards or run from wild animals.

The video below shows how it works.
[previewyoutube=f892fUoEnjg;full][/previewyoutube]

Meanwhile, we continue adding new items, recipes, foods and traps. We also continue optimization work. Recently we spotted a well-hidden AI bug that causes massive FPS drops and we sent it straight to Niflheim.

notes.title: Devlog #8 New Screenshots. Development update
notes.content:
[b]Heil![/b]

As You might know, we are preparing our Kickstarter Demo Version. The last months were very heavily loaded in terms of game optimization as system requirements were just too high earlier. Now we are almost happy with the results ;) 

We have implemented various food sources and cooking recipes. Now Raga, our four-legged friend, can hunt small animals as well. We have made series of AI improvements and overall survival balance changes. We don't want to make our Viking constantly hobble through the island, but Ragnar should watch his steps as healing is cost resources.

We were improving the overall game world looks as well.

Our main issue right now is problems with the Save system as we need to properly keep a lot of game world and character equipment and status variables. We are polishing episode with rafting as well. When those will be finished and tested, we will have Kickstarter Demo ready.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35900034/2f69935e17ba6c1ced62eddd5ef0af25705d6b97.jpg[/img]

Meanwhile, we are working on the full version of the game as well. Regardless of the Kickstarter results, our game will be released. We perceive Kickstarter as an opportunity to make our game bigger, better and longer with more awesome features and an authentic Viking castaway experience.

notes.title: Devlog#7 - Lost Viking Kickstarter Delay and Development Status

[b]
We have decided to delay the Kickstarter launch[/b]

notes.title: Devlog#6 A Wolf in enemy teritorry
notes.content:
***
Ragnal woke on impulse. a simple fire burned out near a half-collapsed shelter, which the survivor was lucky enough to find before sunset. In a sudden rush of memories, he remembered yesterday's events. Cursed be this day! Ship, ambush, river, death and... [b]life![/b]

Only now did he realize that [b]Raga, the Grey Wolf[/b] companion of his has gone.

Ragnald stood up suddenly, looking for his friend, but the fresh wounds, though temporarily bandaged,
did not bode well for him in battle any time soon.
A few strong curses disturb the silence of the morning

A weapon... Ragnald had to get one. A veteran warrior without a weapon felt almost naked.
- Tools might be more important for now - Ragnald whispered to himself while looking at the agonal state of his shelter and start looking for Raga.
His four-legged friend probably went hunting and that means, he doesn't found any dangers around. 
Fortunately, the wounds, though aching, did not prevent Ragnald from moving. The herbs he found worked wonders!

- Time to see, where exactly am I - Lost Viking decided after finishing yesterday meal.
Last day he saw friendly boats crashing on another side of a river. On his side, nobody has survived.

A few hours later, Ragnald and Raga found a lumberjack camp.
- They have to have tools, maybe weapons, an axe for sure. Stay low Raga! - Ragnal whispered.
- We cannot fight them...not yet...
***
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35900034/9d709fc97757417ee8dcdf0c4512b08ecbfc1f5f.jpg[/img]
[i]Lumberjack Camp is well guarded... but they have tools Ragnal need to survive[/i]

Heil!

Two months have passed since we have published our Steam Game Festival: Autumn Edition demo. Thanks to You Vikings we were able to collect a tremendous amount of feedback! Since then we put a lot of hard work into our game to make the Kingdom of Woman a place, where one can truly feel lost... and charmed.
Our brave Viking crashed on enemy territory, lost his equipment and most of the companions. To survive Ragnal need to prepare for his journey and he is Viking after all, he is going to take what he needs straight from the enemy. Preferably without them noticing this... Nec Hercules contra plures...

[previewyoutube=BIwSrvzkQAE;full][/previewyoutube][i]Still improving Enemy AI and playing with balance but we like how sneaking feel for now[/i]

[h3][b]Beware cautious guards!:[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35900034/61b3a55204bb5c4a1b796df63c33f60eb3eb4e75.gif[/img]
[i]They know somebody could survive a crash[/i]

[b]Currently, we are working on:[/b]
- New missions
- Enemy AI
- Raga AI (our four-legged friend)
- Wildlife AI
- Improving Visuals and sounds
- and much, much more!

[b]Sjáumst![/b]

notes.title: DevLog#5
notes.content:
After finding a safe place to stay for a night, Ragnald fries hunted rabbit meat over the fire. The warrior takes a full bite of sizzling meat and throws the wolf a bone.

-	That was a long day, my friend. We need to rest… we need to rest well because tomorrow we’ll seek our queen. Dear goods! Don’t let her die in this savage land!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35900034/581e1b63c01a6ebba71ab76433fc94609e28f441.jpg[/img]

Heil!

Being alone on the unknown lands ain’t easy for sure. Our hero needs to take care about himself creating the tools he needs to pass his path and food so he don’t starve along the journey. That’s why we have introduced crafting and inventory system into the game.

Currently we are still working on:
-	detailing the environment of the first chapter in-game world
-	putting interactions into the game world
-	making our faithful animal friend accompanying the hero
-	player inventory

Sjáumst!

-	Forestlight Games Development Team

notes.title: DevLog#4
notes.content:
The passage in front of our hero leads onto an old, suspension bridge. Some of planks are so old, that easily breaks under the weight of the viking. One has to calculate each step carefully to not fall into the depths of the abyss.

-	Is it the way to another side or straight to Helheim, the kingdom of Death. I will find it out soon!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35900034/8813206448ac01957f15f3d9f3b2e273e5428dd3.jpg[/img]

Heil!

The environment around our heroic viking is constantly changing. He travels through sunny plains, rapid rivers and deadly rocky passages. He even crawls into darkest dungeons to find a way through a blocked mountain high road. He probably couldn't’ make it that easy if not his crafting skills and helpful tools he made.

Currently we are still working on:
-	interactions with the created world
-	equipment and crafting
-	balancing movement controller

Sjáumst!

-	Forestlight Games Development Team

notes.title: DevLog#03
notes.content:
The Viking takes one of the well burnt log from a fire. Moving slowly he set another poles with dismembered viking heads on fire.

-	Ozur… Beiner... Thialfi… Eid... Kollsvein... Geri... Finn...  Agnar… March proudly through the gardens of Valhalla, because your bravery and fortitude were equal to none! March proudly, you invincible warriors, to the heavenly Asgard to feast among the gods! Your story will not be forgotten…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35900034/8813206448ac01957f15f3d9f3b2e273e5428dd3.jpg[/img]

Heil!

The area of attack has been abandoned already, when Ragnald reached its destination. He needs to find a trail in which direction the kingdom of women had left. That new territory is harsh, covered by rocky mountains full with treacherous paths. In that unknown ground our heroic viking finds a way through lost temple filled with deadly traps. When he manage to get through it he spot a sinister view over newly found valley.

Ragnald has already walked quite a significant distance, but there’s still more to travel to accomplish his mission.

Currently we are working on:
-	interactions with the created world
-	equipment and crafting
-	balancing movement controller

Sjáumst!

Forestlight Games Development Team

notes.title: DevLog#2
notes.content:
***

Ragnal falls on his knees, seeing what happened to his companions. In his fists, he grabs the soil wet with blood and raises his head towards the sky. His cry is full of despair:

“Mighty gods! Why?!! Why did you let my soul suffer this unbearable pain? All of them are gone… My warriors, my companions, my brothers, I swear to you, your death will be avenged!”.

The Viking gaze falls on a gold-green ribbon fastened to one of the sticks, that is waving in the wind. A tear runs down the warrior's cheek.

“Where are you, my brightest sunshine? Are you already by the gates of Valhalla? Or surrounded by these doomed knaves? Either way, I will join you soon!” 


***

[img]https://i.imgur.com/XxA1rL8.jpg[/img]

Heil!

Ragnal, the mighty viking warrior, now has more terrain to explore! But some areas are inhabited with hostile natives that he needs to avoid - he still is not fully recovered after the attack. In the area, he needs to find a way to get to the other side from where the attack took place.
Somehow he manages to get to the other side and finds himself lost. After searching for the correct path he finally gets to the spot where his newly found enemy had set up a camp and kept their captives - Ragnald’s friends.

That's not all. There’s still more to travel through before our hero finds his lost love.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/6Nvarsb.jpg[/img]

Currently, we are working on:
new terrain to explore
balancing movement controller

Sjáumst!

Forestlight Games Development Team

notes.title: DevLog#1
notes.content:
***

Ragnal, a middle-age, robust man lays deeply wounded on the edge of the river. A wolf licks his face. The Viking looms in his sleep:

“Tove! Tove! My dearest angel! I will come back… I will come back for you…”.

The warrior slowly regains his consciousness. With a wounded hand pushes away his animal friend and sits up with a grimace of pain. He turns his head around and speaks more to himself then his loyal follower:

“She’s gone, my friend... Our queen is taken away and my soul is bleeding far more than these wounds. I’d prefer to suffer a thousand deaths than to see her gone…” 

However, he’s seriously injured, he managed to stand up. Looks in the sky and with clenched fist vows:

“Almighty gods! Have mercy on me... and let me fight her back!”

***
[img]https://i.imgur.com/JmvXsRc.gif[/img]
In this adventure game, the player takes control over a Viking - Ragnald. His definitive goal is to free his significant other from enslavement. But first, he needs to find her on unknown lands. With help comes his animal friend - grey wolf Raga.

At the current, early stage of production Ragnal can explore riverbank on which he and his tribe were sneakily attacked and almost totally annihilated. Along the way, he finds some useful stuff that can help him survive in the wilds. That’s how the story begins.

Stay tuned for more news and plots that we plan to upload on a regular basis. 

Vér sjáumst!
Forestlight Games Development Team
